output_publication_scope: Extract publishes the created root directory only; restore/create report the actual unique target before writing. Queue updates only active tasks and changed paths; finish preserves a published path even if Result has none; retry clears the old target and uses a fresh unique target. A reported file target may not yet exist if writing has not begun or failed before creation.
batch_pause_scope: Formal runner checks a request at task boundaries only. Tests cover successful current extraction, pending and newly admitted work retained, retracting pause, resume without redoing completed output, and immediate-stop priority. Menu/keyboard/finish adapters were read-only reviewed; no native UI was operated.
automatic_password_hint_scope: Generated public hints only: shared bounded strict UTF-8 reader, BOM-only and leading/trailing-space behavior, invalid UTF-8/binary/exclusive-locked hints skipped independently, filename archive/volume suffix candidate plus exact fallback, preferred candidate retained, no read-only ranking write. Real 7z extraction from BOM hint and saved password despite bad hint. Regex constructed once, ordered set for stable uniqueness, sort outside book lock. 5000-candidate timing excludes KDF/probing/archive decode/UI.
scan_change_scope: Generated inbox with two disguised ZIP files. During the first scan progress callback one input was renamed into the same isolated fixture outside inbox and retained; changed entry was skipped with a path/warning and the remaining archive extracted real payload. Root errors, iterator increment errors and cancellation cannot return complete success. No user file moved, modified, recycled or deleted.
reason_retry_scope: Four appended reason filters require Attention and intersect source, creation target, failed inner file and output path query. New menu is disabled and command rejects while running/closing; preparation never invokes start. Real mixed encrypted/volume/source failures -> isolated password import -> only two visible password tasks prepared -> explicit runner -> correct payload; hidden failures unchanged.
queue_reorder_scope: Single Queue.reorder replaces removed Queue.move. Waiting slots only (paused included); Running splits segments, history slots stay fixed. Full Task values move, source indexes stay valid, one revision per changed operation. Model covers no-op, disjoint/edge blocks, history/running anchors, paused reader/policy, independent focus/anchor. Real running reorder validates each startup ID and decoded payload; paused priority survives a saved workspace and later continuation without redoing completed output.
queue_reorder_timing_scope: Two Queue.reorder calls on 5000 generated nonexistent metadata paths with 2500 selected, plus immediate return-count/revision assertions. No disk attributes, archive open/decode, native redraw, clipboard or real input hashing. Timing is not a GUI/extraction performance result.
task_menu_ipc_scope: Source review only: while task popup is open, incoming WM_COPYDATA paths enter queue with navigate=false; addFiles refreshes without a forced new single selection, including modal callers. Actual popup/IPC delivery was not exercised.
typed_progress_scope: Single four-argument Progress contract with explicit None/Bytes/Files/Candidates/Items at production sites. Same ProgressGate in core handles GUI 90ms and CLI 1s, always publishes initial/stage/unit/total/reset events; other events coalesced, including comparison with unpublished observed counts. SDK initial stage event precedes the actual operation. Deterministic clock test covers intervals and 1s CLI stage changes. Real nested callback observations confirm root decode -> candidate verification -> inner decode with correct units and payload.
progress_runtime_scope: Raw done/total/unit and steady-clock task start are transient. Footer counts and this-attempt elapsed update through the current running ID, including filtered/hidden tasks; timer only changes status text, not details/caret/list or queue revision. Session bytes remain unchanged across runtime progress; format remains compatible. Percentage is current stage. SDK processed bytes can mean packed or unpacked bytes by format; no speed or whole-task ETA is inferred.
volume_cancel_reuse_scope: Progress checks before resolving and at directory entries, candidates, and numbered/RAR volume boundaries. Typed cancellation bypasses normal resolver fallback; cache is installed only after complete construction. Success/root/manual flags scope to the current input; child probing/extraction use child-specific flags and per-level resolver. Real three disguised sources inspected/restored/extracted with one root directory metadata snapshot and verified decoded bytes. Existing fresh retry, root/nested source retention, manual/RAR and renamed-volume regressions remain passing.
cancel_status_scope: Typed cancellation and native SDK E_ABORT use a shared classifier; selectArchive propagates SDK abort before wrong-password fallback, and inspect/extract/restore/create keep cancellation ahead of missing-volume or verification-failed classification. Real checks cover partial directory cache cancellation/resume, candidate cancellation/resume, runner stops before output without swallowing cancel, single-shot scan/nested/diagnostic cancellation, full verification initial stop, actual second SDK verification callback stop, and actual second SDK password-probe callback stop. No hard latency benchmark; single OS/SDK/KDF calls still need to return.
zip_priority_scope: ZIP metadata opens first without KDF. Known lowest-cost encrypted entry <=1MiB enables first four ranked nonempty original candidates plus encoding variants; <=8 variants run same verifier inline; passing headers require full native SDK testItem even with one surviving variant. Weak ZipCrypto collision flows back to original parallel tail; large/unknown probes use full bulk strategy. Final extraction still verifies all data. Real plain/encrypted metadata/restore, Unicode/ACP, descriptors, empty encrypted entries, large probe, unsupported method and three cancellation boundaries covered.
precise_location_scope: One ShellLocation constructor checks exact path and prepares absolute native PIDL; files select exact item with SHOpenFolderAndSelectItems(fullPIDL,0,nullptr,0), directories open contents; explicit source/problem location selects even directories. Tests prepare only, never call open or Explorer. Real nested failures keep outer source versus inner failedFile versus root output distinct; create/restore target checks use actual uniquePath and preserve conflicting original bytes. Missing exact item cannot fall back to existing parent. Single-selection/closing/runtime menu adapters read-only reviewed.
zip_priority_performance_report: zip-priority-performance.json; current 0.13 small generated AES ZIP, 513 saved candidates, five interleaved fresh-book samples each; first batch 4 versus tail batch 509 after first 4. No old-build/all-format speed claim.
nested_repair_scope: One nestedTask helper requires Extract Attention/Cancelled and a failedFile strictly within root output, different from root inputs; excludes source_unavailable and other actions. Fresh Task receives only child path and policy copied from explicit parent or current batch snapshot, output changed to child parent directory. Same helper supplies volume drafts. No parent reset/completion or automatic run. Real encrypted inner repair with isolated saved key, workspace roundtrip and changed batch defaults runs only child and preserves parent/root note/conflicting folder bytes. Actual inner-stage cancellation restarts into new unique directory, retaining partial output. Prepared generated child moved to retained fixture gives source_unavailable without changing parent. Existing nested volume repair verifies shared settings and local output. All fixtures disable recycle.
nested_context_scope: Each recursive call restores its current child only when an exception leaves failedFile empty. More deeply reported failures remain unchanged. Generated outer -> inner -> deep plus later ordinary file: move later entry to retained fixture after deep starts; deep completes, later read fails, failure points to inner package; a separate real inner task decodes deep successfully without re-extracting outer. Source moves remain within generated workspace; no file removed.
nested_repair_limitations: A separately successful inner task does not finish or clean the failed outer task, resume its old output, or process other unvisited inner archives. UI states this explicitly. Password remains current batch or encrypted book context, never task/session plaintext. Command/menu operation itself is source-reviewed, not operated.
